Clockwork Scout (CV 5)

A small brass surveying machine with jointed feet, a glass lens and a speaking grille. Its precise movements serve observation and reporting rather than a sustained fight.

HP: 6 · Speed: Ground 6; climb 5 · Footprint: 1x1

Summoned form — player reference.

Defense modifier: 1 Boon. · Stability: 0.

DR / resistance: None · Condition immunities: Bleeding; Poisoned; Asleep

Weakness: None

Healing: Summoned energy form: cannot be healed; disappears at 0 HP without leaving a body.

Senses: Ordinary sight and hearing.

Communication: Reports simple spoken directions while active

Attributes: Brawn -1; Fortitude +0; Agility +2; Guile -1; Knowledge +1; Reason +1

Eligibility: Construct 1

Main command: Main + Maneuver; Maneuver command: Maneuver + movement. One command per summon per controller turn; immediate summoning command counts. No activity or alerts without a command; no Reactions or opportunity attacks. Turn ticks use controller’s turn. Beyond 6 squares, or controller unconscious/dead, it disappears; at 0 HP it disappears. No permanent loot.

Carrying: up to 1 Bulk; anatomy limits handling. No granted crafting training.

Roll its printed attack attribute and read the attacker outcomes below. When it is attacked, roll the defense attribute named by the incoming attack. Passive defenses remain; no independent active effects.

Lifeless Body — Passive: does not breathe or eat; only listed immunities apply.

Attacks — Main Action

AttackAttributeAttack modifierWeak attackStandard attackStrong attack
NeedleAgility1 Bane1 physical damage.2 physical damage.3 physical damage.

Needle: One adjacent creature.

Maneuvers

Roll Away — Maneuver

The goblin drops a shoulder, tumbles across the rubble and springs up beyond the answering blade.

Move up to 2 squares in a straight line without provoking opportunity attacks. Pay normal terrain costs from the 2-square allowance. Normal occupied-square restrictions apply.

Use only as part of a command; no independent activity.

Defend — Maneuver: gain 1 Boon to defenses until the start of the controller’s next turn; repeated Defend does not stack.

Basic Melee — Main: 1 Bane to attack; Brawn, one adjacent target; Weak attack 1, Standard 2, Strong 4 physical damage. No specialty riders. No opportunity Reaction.
